subject: Re: Newsletter giveaway — access keys for August campaign
messages:
From: Sara Lima <sara@brightline.media>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@brightline.media
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: newsletter giveaway access keys for August issue

Hi Jonas,

We run a weekly newsletter (BrightLine Digest) and have an upcoming August 12 edition where we'd like to offer readers a small technical trial to try Redwood Inference (7-day access). Can you provide 150 single-use access keys or promo codes that grant a 7-day trial?

Key details:
- Campaign date: distribution in the newsletter on 2026-08-12
- Expected redemptions: ~60–100 (we want headroom)
- Expiration on codes: prefer 30 days from issuance
- Tracking: we'd like a column for code, issued_at, redeemed_at if you can provide a csv back

Please let me know any constraints (billing, quota, or approvals) and whether you need an MSA addendum or PO. We're happy to log this in HubSpot if needed.

Thanks —
Sara
Sara Lima
Partnerships Lead, BrightLine Media
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Lima <sara@brightline.media>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: newsletter giveaway access keys for August issue

Marissa / Vanessa — forwarding BrightLine's ask below. Quick summary: they want 150 single-use promo codes (7-day trial) for a newsletter send on Aug 12. They expect 60–100 redemptions.

Questions for approvals:
- Marissa: do we approve 150 fully free 7-day trials out of marketing partner budget, or do we cap free trials to 100 and apply a discounted-rate fallback for the rest?
- Vanessa: if approved, can we bill the marketing/promotions budget code and/or create an internal charge to track these credits (they want a csv back with redemption timestamps)?

I think a conservative approach (100 free + 50 discounted) makes sense given expected redemption. If it's approved, I can generate the codes and deliver a CSV to Sara and upload the tracking to the promo sheet.

Related: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XgPromoTrackerAug2026
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/BLM-2026-082

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: newsletter giveaway access keys for August issue

Thanks for the context. Approve as follows:
- 100 complimentary 7-day trial codes charged to Marketing promo pool (MG-2026-08).
- Remaining 50 should be created as 7-day trial codes but marked in the tracker as "50% subsidized" — Sara can offer them but we'd expect BrightLine to cover partial cost if redeemed beyond a set threshold.

Please attach a short approval stub (I signed off) for finance. See attached (redwood_promo_approval_aug2026.pdf).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Growth Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: newsletter giveaway access keys for August issue

Acknowledged. Budget code MG-2026-08 will cover 100 free trials. Finance will log the batch under promo charge ID: PROMO-082-2026. For the 50 subsidized codes, create them but tag them with the label "50pct_subsidy_BLM" in the tracker — we'll invoice BrightLine for any redeemed subsidized codes after the campaign.

I will notate the deal in the billing tracker and will accept a CSV with columns: code, issued_at, expires_at, redeemed_at, subsidy_flag.

Vanessa Ortiz
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lima <sara@brightline.media>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 07:52:00 -0700
Subject: Access keys for BrightLine Digest (Aug 12) — delivery

Hi Sara,

Thanks — approved. Attached are the 150 single-use access keys (promo_codes_batch_Aug2026.csv). Delivery notes:
- 100 codes = complimentary 7-day trial (tag: FREE_BLM_AUG12)
- 50 codes = 7-day trial (tag: 50pct_subsidy_BLM) — we'll invoice BrightLine for any subsidized redemptions after the campaign per Vanessa's note
- Codes expire: 2026-09-02 (30 days from issuance)
- Please share redeemed_at timestamps when you can so we can reconcile invoicing

Attachment: promo_codes_batch_Aug2026.csv (columns: code, issued_at, expires_at, subsidy_flag)

Let me know if you want the codes split into smaller batches or a redirect link for signups.

Best,
Jonas
From: Sara Lima <sara@brightline.media>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@brightline.media

Perfect — thanks so much, Jonas. We'll integrate the CSV into our distribution pipeline and confirm redemptions after the send. Appreciate the quick turnaround and the promo support!
